title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s)
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden Tracking Area Identities to be stored in the list of 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service. This IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite NG-RAN access.

entities.name: 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service
entities.description: A list maintained by the UE containing forbidden Tracking Area Identities for regional service provision.

entities.name: Message sent via satellite NG-RAN access
entities.description: Condition that the message is transmitted over satellite NG-RAN access, which triggers the inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE.

relations.description: The Forbidden TAI(s) IE provides the forbidden tracking areas to be stored in the list for regional service provision.
The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is conditional upon the message being sent via satellite NG-RAN access.
